g.desc: Physical application component APP-001: Payment service. In Payment services. Application execution serves it; Transactional persistence serves it; Service connectivity serves it; Identity and access decisions serves it; Correlated operational evidence serves it (degraded); Recoverable state copies serves it.

Physical application component APP-002: Risk engine. In Payment services. Application execution serves it; Transactional persistence serves it; Identity and access decisions serves it; Correlated operational evidence serves it (degraded); Recoverable state copies serves it.

Physical application component APP-003: Core connector. In Payment services. Application execution serves it; Service connectivity serves it; Identity and access decisions serves it; Correlated operational evidence serves it (degraded).

Physical application component APP-004: Settlement worker. In Payment services. Application execution serves it; Transactional persistence serves it; Durable work handoff serves it; Service connectivity serves it; Identity and access decisions serves it; Correlated operational evidence serves it (degraded); Recoverable state copies serves it; Controlled service recovery serves it.

Physical application component APP-005: Notification worker. In Payment services. Application execution serves it; Durable work handoff serves it; Service connectivity serves it; Identity and access decisions serves it; Correlated operational evidence serves it (degraded).

Logical technology component TC-001: Application execution (compute). In Run. It serves Payment service; serves Risk engine; serves Core connector; serves Settlement worker; serves Notification worker; depends on Service connectivity; depends on Correlated operational evidence (not critical).
Logical technology component TC-002: Transactional persistence (transactional). In Keep state. It serves Payment service; serves Risk engine; serves Settlement worker.
Technology service TC-003: Durable work handoff (messaging). In Connect. It serves Settlement worker; serves Notification worker; depends on Correlated operational evidence (not critical).
Logical technology component TC-004: Disposable read acceleration (caching). In Keep state.

Technology service TC-005: Service connectivity (connectivity). In Connect. It serves Payment service; serves Core connector; serves Settlement worker; serves Notification worker; depends on Identity and access decisions. Application execution depends on it.

Technology service TC-006: Identity and access decisions (identity). In Trust. It serves Payment service; serves Risk engine; serves Core connector; serves Settlement worker; serves Notification worker. Service connectivity depends on it.

Logical technology component TC-007: Correlated operational evidence (observability). In Operate. It serves Payment service (degraded); serves Risk engine (degraded); serves Core connector (degraded); serves Settlement worker (degraded); serves Notification worker (degraded). Application execution depends on it (not critical); Durable work handoff depends on it (not critical).
Logical technology component TC-008: Recoverable state copies (backup). In Keep state. It serves Payment service; serves Risk engine; serves Settlement worker.
Logical technology component TC-009: Controlled service recovery (recovery). In Operate. It serves Settlement worker.
